description: MLIT Data Platform (国土交通データプラットフォーム) is a data portal run by Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT), Japan. The platform links national data on infrastructure, land, disasters and transport held by MLIT and partners, including bridge, tunnel and dam inspection records, ground-survey borings, 3D city models and river data, with a search and API service for developers. Coverage: Japan (nationwide, with local government data). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as api, json, csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("国土交通データプラットフォーム ドメイン移行のお知らせ") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. The home page read on 2026-09-30 carried a notice about a domain move, so links may change. It can support asset condition, hazard exposure and digital-twin studies of Japanese roads, bridges and dams. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
